title: nan
authors: Zahran S.; Moussa A.M.; El-Sheimy N.; Sesay A.B.
key_contribution: Proposes velocity estimation from an array of hall effect sensors (Air-Odo) to enhance UAV navigation during complete GNSS outages, with indoor experimental flight results.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
